tools.name: quiz
tools.description: Ask the learner one graded multiple-choice question as a clickable card; blocks until answered and returns the graded result with his confidence and optional note. Use for probes, predictions and checks.

kind.description: probe = level mapping; predict = before teaching a node; check = after teaching it

nodeId.description: Plan node id such as "N3". Required for predict and check.

question.description: Exactly one question; markdown and LaTeX allowed.

options.description: 2 to 6 bare claims. Never add an I-dont-know option: the app adds it.

multiSelect.description: Set when more than one option is correct.

explanation.description: Shown after answering, whether right or wrong.

correctAnswer.description: Option value(s) (the label when no value was given), not positions.

misconceptions.description: Per wrong option: the misconception it probes.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask the learner an ungraded question (goal, preference, fork) as a card; blocks until answered. Use quiz for anything with a right answer.

options.description: Omit for a free-text answer. An Altro free-text row is always added.

tools.name: propose_curriculum
tools.description: Show the learner the destination and ordered lesson list and wait for approval (blocks); on approval writes curriculum.json (and MISSION.md for a new course).

slug.description: Course directory name under courses/, kebab-case.

destination.description: 1-2 sentences: where the learner ends up.

mission.description: Full MISSION.md (Why / Success looks like / Constraints / Out of scope). Required when the course directory is new.

title.description: Names the insight, not the topic.

slug.description: Legacy only: file slug of an already-taught lesson whose name differs from its title. Normally omit.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Start a background web research subagent (WebSearch/WebFetch). Returns at once with a job id; the sourced brief arrives later as a message from the app.

question.description: The precise question to verify, in the learner's language.

context.description: What the lesson is about and what version/constraints matter; the researcher sees nothing else.

tools.name: read_lesson
tools.description: Read a lesson artifact as compact text: per node its title, tier, prose, code, connection, check question and card. Pass nodeIds to read only those nodes. Use this instead of Read on lesson HTML.

nodeIds.description: Only these nodes (nodeId); omit for the whole lesson.

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Search his knowledge graph by meaning (Italian or English) over name, statement and aliases; falls back to lexical matching when the local model is missing. Returns at most 10 concepts, one per line: id | name | status (solido, fragile, insegnato, mancato) | course | lesson.

query.description: What the concept is about, in Italian or English (words or a short phrase).

tools.name: open_concept
tools.description: Open one concept of his knowledge graph: statement, status, courses, lessons, MapNode keys, premises and consequences.

id.description: Concept id from search_concepts or browse_concepts (n_...).

tools.name: browse_concepts
tools.description: Browse his knowledge graph: no input lists courses, course lists its lessons, course + lesson lists that lesson's concepts with their status.

course.description: Course slug; omit to list courses.

content.text: slug "altro" must be this session's course "demo".

multiSelect.description: Set when more than one option is correct.

explanation.description: Shown after answering, whether right or wrong.

correctAnswer.description: Option value(s) (the label when no value was given), not positions.

misconceptions.description: Per wrong option: the misconception it probes.

options.description: Omit for a free-text answer. An Altro free-text row is always added.

tools.name: propose_plan
tools.description: Show the learner the lesson approach and dependency DAG and wait for approval (blocks). On approval the lesson artifact is created and nodes can be written with write_node.

topic.description: Lesson topic; also names the Anki deck.

title.description: Only for a free lesson: the title, naming the insight. Ignored when the lesson is planned or existing.

dag.description: Mermaid "graph TD". Every node: N1["Nodo 1: complete Italian clause"]; unconditional truths at the roots, goal at the sink.

goal.description: The learner's goal for the lesson.

tools.name: write_node
tools.description: Write (or replace, same nodeId) one node into the lesson artifact and show it to the learner. Requires an approved plan. Every new idea carries `anchors` (n_… ids and names from the concept tools) and its prose names those concepts.

nodeId.description: Unique in the lesson; writing the same nodeId again replaces the node.

summary.description: Concise 1-2 sentence distilled claim for the Sintesi reference sheet.

content.description: Authored HTML or prose: the Establish step.

anchors.description: Known concepts this idea builds on: id and name from search_concepts/open_concept/browse_concepts. Name them in the prose too.

correctAnswer.description: The text of the correct option; must equal options[correctIndex - 1].

ankiParams.description: Only when the learner opted in AND passed the check for this node: write the node first without it, then rewrite the same nodeId with ankiParams after the pass.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Start a background web research subagent (WebSearch/WebFetch). Returns at once with a job id; the sourced brief arrives later as a message from the app.

question.description: The precise question to verify, in the learner's language.

context.description: What the lesson is about and what version/constraints matter; the researcher sees nothing else.

tools.name: visual
tools.description: Start a background subagent that draws one SVG figure and checks it by rendering it. Returns at once with a job id; the figure appears in the chat when ready.

brief.description: Self-contained description of the figure: what to show, the labels (Italian), the relations. The visual-maker sees nothing else of the lesson.

tools.name: demo
tools.description: Start a background subagent that builds one interactive single-file HTML demo and tests it headless. Returns at once with a job id; the demo appears in the chat when ready.

title.description: Short Italian title of the demo.

brief.description: Self-contained description of what the learner can manipulate and what it should make visible. The demo-builder sees nothing else of the lesson.

tools.name: sync_anki
tools.description: Sync the lesson's Anki cards (only exists when the learner opted in). Safe to call repeatedly: duplicates are skipped.

tools.name: write_exercise
tools.description: Write a coding exercise (files plus instructions) into courses/<course>/exercises/<name>/ and show it to the learner, who solves it in the app's built-in editor and runs the tests there (results reach you as "Esito test" messages).

instructions.description: Markdown shown on the exercise card; also written to ISTRUZIONI.md.

files.description: Paths relative to the exercise dir (.vue .js .ts .json .css .md).

hints.description: Progressive hints, weakest first (nudge, concept/API, near-solution). Italian markdown. The learner reveals them one at a time.

final.description: True for the lesson's final semi-guided exercise.

tools.name: run_exercise
tools.description: Run the tests of one exercise and return passed/failed with failure messages. The result is also shown to the learner.

tools.name: finish_lesson
tools.description: Close the lesson: compile the reference sheet, write the learning record (for the teacher), optionally append to NOTES.md and sync Anki. If the lesson already has its record, only the reference sheet is refreshed (and Anki resynced).

recordTitle.description: What became true, e.g. 'Il contratto del componente: acquisito'.

evidence.description: What he actually did: quiz results, slips, quotes (markdown).

implications.description: What the next session must do differently (markdown).

notesAddendum.description: What was learned about teaching him; appended to NOTES.md.

  <!-- Client-side KaTeX & Mermaid Theme Controller Script -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
      if (typeof renderMathInElement === "function") {
        renderMathInElement(document.body, {
          delimiters: [
            {left: "$$", right: "$$", display: true},
            {left: "$", right: "$", display: false},
            {left: "\\(", right: "\\)", display: false},
            {left: "\\[", right: "\\]", display: true}
          ],
          throwOnError: false,
          errorColor: "#dc2626"
        });
      }
    });

    (function() {
      document.querySelectorAll(".mermaid").forEach(function(el) {
        el.dataset.mermaidSource = el.textContent.trim();
      });

      function renderMermaid(themeName) {
        if (typeof mermaid === "undefined") return;
        
        document.querySelectorAll(".mermaid").forEach(function(el) {
          if (el.dataset.mermaidSource) {
            el.removeAttribute("data-processed");
            el.innerHTML = el.dataset.mermaidSource;
          }
        });

        mermaid.initialize({
          startOnLoad: false,
          theme: themeName === "dark" ? "dark" : "default",
          securityLevel: "loose",
          fontFamily: '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif'
        });

        mermaid.run();
      }

      const currentTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light";
      renderMermaid(currentTheme);

      const toggleBtn = document.getElementById("themeToggleBtn");
      const toggleIcon = document.getElementById("themeToggleIcon");
      const toggleText = document.getElementById("themeToggleText");

      function updateToggleUI(theme) {
        if (!toggleIcon || !toggleText) return;
        if (theme === "dark") {
          toggleIcon.textContent = "☀️";
          toggleText.textContent = "Light Mode";
        } else {
          toggleIcon.textContent = "🌙";
          toggleText.textContent = "Dark Mode";
        }
      }

      updateToggleUI(currentTheme);

      if (toggleBtn) {
        toggleBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
          const activeTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme");
          const nextTheme = activeTheme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
          
          document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", nextTheme);
          localStorage.setItem("learn-forme-theme", nextTheme);
          updateToggleUI(nextTheme);
          renderMermaid(nextTheme);
        });
      }

      // Interactive Quizzes Controller
      function initInteractiveQuizzes() {
        document.querySelectorAll(".step-quiz").forEach(function(quizEl) {
          const buttons = quizEl.querySelectorAll(".quiz-option-btn");
          const feedback = quizEl.querySelector(".quiz-feedback-banner");
          const feedbackTitle = quizEl.querySelector(".quiz-feedback-title");
          const feedbackDetail = quizEl.querySelector(".quiz-feedback-detail");
          const actionBar = quizEl.querySelector(".quiz-action-bar");
          const retryBtn = quizEl.querySelector(".quiz-retry-btn");
          const revealDetails = quizEl.querySelector(".quiz-reveal");

          if (!buttons.length) return;

          buttons.forEach(function(btn) {
            btn.addEventListener("click", function() {
              if (quizEl.dataset.answered === "true") return;
              quizEl.dataset.answered = "true";

              const isCorrect = btn.classList.contains("is-correct-target");
              const misconception = btn.getAttribute("data-misconception");

              buttons.forEach(function(b) {
                b.classList.add("is-disabled");
                if (b.classList.contains("is-correct-target")) {
                  b.classList.add("is-answered-correct");
                  const status = b.querySelector(".quiz-option-status");
                  if (status) status.textContent = "✓ Corretto";
                }
              });

              if (isCorrect) {
                btn.classList.add("is-answered-correct");
                if (feedback) {
                  feedback.className = "quiz-feedback-banner is-correct-banner";
                  feedback.style.display = "block";
                  if (feedbackTitle) feedbackTitle.innerHTML = "<strong>✓ Risposta Esatta!</strong>";
                  if (feedbackDetail) feedbackDetail.textContent = "Comprensione confermata: hai individuato il principio corretto.";
                }
              } else {
                btn.classList.add("is-answered-wrong");
                const status = btn.querySelector(".quiz-option-status");
                if (status) status.textContent = "✗ Non corretto";

                if (feedback) {
                  feedback.className = "quiz-feedback-banner is-wrong-banner";
                  feedback.style.display = "block";
                  if (feedbackTitle) feedbackTitle.innerHTML = "<strong>✗ Risposta non corretta</strong>";
                  if (feedbackDetail) {
                    if (misconception) {
                      feedbackDetail.innerHTML = "<strong>Diagnosi dell'errore:</strong> " + misconception;
                    } else {
                      feedbackDetail.textContent = "Osserva la risposta corretta evidenziata in verde e consulta la spiegazione dettagliata qui sotto.";
                    }
                  }
                }
              }

              if (revealDetails) {
                revealDetails.open = true;
              }

              if (actionBar) {
                actionBar.style.display = "flex";
              }
            });
          });

          if (retryBtn) {
            retryBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
              delete quizEl.dataset.answered;
              buttons.forEach(function(b) {
                b.classList.remove("is-disabled", "is-answered-correct", "is-answered-wrong");
                const status = b.querySelector(".quiz-option-status");
                if (status) status.textContent = "";
              });
              if (feedback) feedback.style.display = "none";
              if (actionBar) actionBar.style.display = "none";
            });
          }
        });
      }

      initInteractiveQuizzes();
    })();
  </script>

tools.name: quiz
tools.description: Ask the learner one graded multiple-choice question as a clickable card; blocks until answered and returns the graded result with his confidence and optional note. Use for probes, predictions and checks.

kind.description: probe = level mapping; predict = before teaching a node; check = after teaching it

nodeId.description: Plan node id such as "N3". Required for predict and check.

question.description: Exactly one question; markdown and LaTeX allowed.

options.description: 2 to 6 bare claims. Never add an I-dont-know option: the app adds it.

multiSelect.description: Set when more than one option is correct.

explanation.description: Shown after answering, whether right or wrong.

correctAnswer.description: Option value(s) (the label when no value was given), not positions.

misconceptions.description: Per wrong option: the misconception it probes.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask the learner an ungraded question (goal, preference, fork) as a card; blocks until answered. Use quiz for anything with a right answer.

options.description: Omit for a free-text answer. An Altro free-text row is always added.

tools.name: problem
tools.description: Show the learner a practice problem card. Non-blocking: coach his attempt in chat, then call conclude. Only one problem may be open.

modelSolution.description: Hidden from the learner until conclude.

tools.name: conclude
tools.description: Close the open practice problem with the outcome, highest hint rung, miss class and whether to retest. Free practice: nothing is recorded toward mastery.

rung.description: Highest hint rung used, or null.

missClass.description: Why he missed, or null when solved cleanly.

retest.description: Whether to bring this node back later.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Start a background web research subagent (WebSearch/WebFetch). Returns at once with a job id; the sourced brief arrives later as a message from the app.

question.description: The precise question to verify, in the learner's language.

context.description: What the lesson is about and what version/constraints matter; the researcher sees nothing else.

tools.name: visual
tools.description: Start a background subagent that draws one SVG figure and checks it by rendering it. Returns at once with a job id; the figure appears in the chat when ready.

brief.description: Self-contained description of the figure: what to show, the labels (Italian), the relations. The visual-maker sees nothing else of the lesson.

tools.name: write_exercise
tools.description: Write a coding exercise (files plus instructions) into courses/<course>/exercises/<name>/ and show it to the learner, who solves it in the app's built-in editor and runs the tests there (results reach you as "Esito test" messages).

instructions.description: Markdown shown on the exercise card; also written to ISTRUZIONI.md.

files.description: Paths relative to the exercise dir (.vue .js .ts .json .css .md).

hints.description: Progressive hints, weakest first (nudge, concept/API, near-solution). Italian markdown. The learner reveals them one at a time.

final.description: True for the lesson's final semi-guided exercise.

tools.name: run_exercise
tools.description: Run the tests of one exercise and return passed/failed with failure messages. The result is also shown to the learner.

tools.name: read_lesson
tools.description: Read a lesson artifact as compact text: per node its title, tier, prose, code, connection, check question and card. Pass nodeIds to read only those nodes. Use this instead of Read on lesson HTML.

nodeIds.description: Only these nodes (nodeId); omit for the whole lesson.

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Search his knowledge graph by meaning (Italian or English) over name, statement and aliases; falls back to lexical matching when the local model is missing. Returns at most 10 concepts, one per line: id | name | status (solido, fragile, insegnato, mancato) | course | lesson.

query.description: What the concept is about, in Italian or English (words or a short phrase).

tools.name: open_concept
tools.description: Open one concept of his knowledge graph: statement, status, courses, lessons, MapNode keys, premises and consequences.

id.description: Concept id from search_concepts or browse_concepts (n_...).

tools.name: browse_concepts
tools.description: Browse his knowledge graph: no input lists courses, course lists its lessons, course + lesson lists that lesson's concepts with their status.

course.description: Course slug; omit to list courses.
